 Don’t Wait, Black Friday Starts Now 
 Black Friday might still be a few weeks away, but the deals will come much sooner than that. And if you’ve learned anything from your friends at Valet. , it’s that waiting until the day before Thanksgiving is a rookie move (and doesn’t necessarily mean getting the best price). Retailers are getting an early start this year, marking down everything from fall wardrobe staples and winter outerwear to grooming essentials, tech and home upgrades. Some of these discounts are already as good as what you’ll find on Black Friday itself. Of course, not every early sale is worth your attention. That’s where we come in.
 We’re keeping tabs on the best promotions, digging through the markdowns and separating the genuinely great deals from the usual retail noise. Whether you’re getting a jump on your gift list or finally buying something you’ve had your eye on, consider this your head start. We’ll be updating this page regularly as new sales drop and better deals emerge, so bookmark it and check back often. The smartest Black Friday shopping starts well before you start thinking about turkey.
 What Makes for a Good Black Friday/Cyber Monday Deal?
 Just like any other discount, there are a lot of factors at play. Our shopping engine system digs into the percentages and pricing history in order to see how current offers compare to earlier markdowns. But the best Black Friday deals ring in at the lowest prices of the year, which is why now’s the time to move.
 Alex Crane 
 Known for its laid-back silhouettes, breezy linen and natural fabrics, Alex Crane makes effortless clothes that feel as good as they look. Black Friday is a great opportunity to score its relaxed trousers, textured shirts and easygoing layers.
 Feather polo, $148 / $104 at Alex Crane 
 Caza knit shirt, $148 / $104 at Alex Crane 
 Pac Shell jacket, $188 / $131 at Alex Crane 
 J.Crew 
 Few brands do modern prep quite like J.Crew , especially when it comes to cozy knits, oxford shirts, relaxed chinos and winter coats. Black Friday is an ideal opportunity to stock up on wardrobe staples and grab a few pieces from its more elevated collections.
 Wool-blend sherpa fleece coverall jacket, $169.99 at J.Crew 
 Quarter-zip pullover, $128 / $82.60 at J.Crew 
 Heritage cotton crewneck sweater, $79.50 / $68.60 at J.Crew 
 Todd Snyder 
 Todd Snyder has a knack for making classic menswear feel modern, whether it's a perfectly cut blazer, luxurious knitwear or a vintage-inspired sweatshirt. Holiday markdowns make this an excellent time to score elevated essentials and statement pieces that might otherwise stretch your budget.
 Denim overshirt, $248 / $124 at Todd Snyder 
 Canopy shirt, $178 / $129 at Todd Snyder 
 Soho cardigan sweatshirt, $248 / $124 at Todd Snyder 
 Abercrombie & Fitch 
 The mall staple has become a reliable source for surprisingly stylish menswear, especially relaxed denim, vintage-inspired sweaters and everyday trousers. They’re also know for deep discounts, especially this time of year, so it’s a smart place to get a lot for your money.
 Premium heavyweight 2.0 tee, $40 / $32.99 at Abercrombie & Fitch 
 Henley sweatshirt, $85 / $69.99 at Abercrombie & Fitch 
 Loose Clean cargo pant, $95 / $69.99 at Abercrombie & Fitch 
 Huckberry 
 Huckberry is a tried-and-true shop for rugged, good-looking gear, from waxed jackets and leather boots to premium denim and everyday carry essentials. Its Black Friday sales are particularly worth checking for investment-worthy outerwear, durable footwear and those clever little upgrades you didn't know you needed.
 Flint and Tinder Mason canvas Barn jacket, $198 / $118 at Huckberry 
 Relwen Highland Blues long-sleeve shirt, $168 / $117 at Huckberry 
 Rhodes Vibram mini lug lace-up boot, $268 / $161 at Huckberry 
 Nike 
 Whether you're due for fresh running shoes, everyday sneakers or new workout gear, Nike's holiday promotions are always worth investigating. Watch for discounts on performance footwear, technical apparel and classic silhouettes that rarely need much convincing.
 24.7 ImpossiblySoft Dri-FIT crew sweatshirt, $115 / $75.97 at Nike 
 Tech fleece jogger, $120 / $69.97 at Nike 
 Pegasus 42 Road running shoe, $145 / $108.97 at Nike 
 Banana Republic 
 Banana Republic’s most recent collections lean into sophisticated tailoring, rich textures and quietly luxurious essentials. Look for deals on cashmere, suede, wool trousers and polished layering pieces that feel considerably more expensive than their sale prices.
 Archive reissue poplin shirt, $98 / $79.99 at Banana Republic 
 Cashmere crew-neck sweater, $160 / $84.99 at Banana Republic 
 Signature Italian hopsack jacket, $450 / $239.99 at Banana Republic 
 Polo Ralph Lauren 
 From iconic cable-knit sweaters and rugby shirts to classic Oxford button-downs and rugged outerwear, Polo remains the gold standard of American prep. Black Friday is a prime time to invest in those timeless pieces that rarely go out of style.
 Polo Ralph Lauren Iconic cable-knit cashmere sweater, $498 / $249.99 at Ralph Lauren 
 Polo Ralph Lauren Flag fleece sweatpant, $140 / $84.99 at Ralph Lauren 
 Polo Ralph Lauren Yankees jacket, $898 / $719.99 at Ralph Lauren 
 Nordstrom 
 With everything from designer footwear and premium denim to grooming products and home essentials, Nordstrom offers plenty of opportunities to score something special. The trick is focusing on quality brands and versatile pieces you’ll actually wear, rather than simply chasing the biggest markdown.
 MALIN+GOETZ Jumbo rum body wash, $51.80 at Nordstrom 
 Wax London Whiting Wye check overshirt, $117.50 at Nordstrom 
 Madewell Shaker stitch cotton sweater, $118 / $82.80 at Nordstrom 
 The Savvy Shopper’s Secret Weapon
 Leverage a Price-Tracking Tool
 Camel Camel Camel is one of the easiest ways to keep tabs on Amazon prices. Install the browser extension and you’ll get all the price-tracking intel without ever leaving Amazon. Or just drop an Amazon link or product name into the site’s search bar. CamelCamelCamel then shows you the full price history—how it’s changed on Amazon itself and what third-party sellers are charging for new or used versions.
 SlickDeals has built a solid reputation for surfacing the latest discounts and coupon codes across the web, but its built-in price tracker is just as handy. It lets you monitor price drops on nearly any Amazon item and on a ton of other popular shopping sites, from Gamestop and Chewy to Home Depot and others.
 Pay Close Attention to Lightning Deals
 Doorbusters, flash sales, and lightning deals are the lifeblood of Black Friday—those blink-and-you’ll-miss-it offers designed to make you hit “buy” without thinking twice. These are the attention-grabbers: the ones with prices so low you’ll swear there’s a typo. As you scan ads and promo pages, pay close attention to the fine print. Some require early sign-ups or midnight refreshes (looking at you, Amazon), and others disappear faster than your morning coffee. Don’t assume you’ll have all weekend—sometimes you’ve got less than an hour.
